review_notes: All30 native bodies and their individual coded/plain/wedge/anonymous terminals and complete orthogonal routes reviewed. Standard banks retained. Native title and corrected source inventory identity are 16-23 24-31-48-55; the hyphen between31 and48 is preserved. Footer has explicitSDD and noBITS prefix.

The two coded right ports BE B07 and BG D02 are outputs. Wider native riser crops show BE B07 feeding R TO AY D06 through the short upper dogleg, and BG D02 feeding R TO BA B10 through the long upper dogleg. Their upper anonymous wedge outputs separately feed N BF/BH unit-row wedge inputs. Root independently confirmed the R TO sink endpoints; no crossing is joined without a diamond.

Native AG lower B12✲ drives BG LEFT D02 wedge. Native AX lower B10✲ drives BE LEFT B07 wedge. Native AX upper B09 feeds AE D12, and AH lower D13✲ continues to AP745. Plain AV/AW outputs are independently traced through their local doglegs into AR and AG/AH.

Printed output stars are retained individually at AN D10, AA B10, AF B10, AG B12, AH D13, AX B10, BB D09 and BD D05. AT D02 has NO star: its adjacent mark is the ordinary crossing of AS D05 vertical return, clearly shown in AT upper output native.png. AS/AT/AU coded outputs have no suffix.

Source annotations are separate literal✲ fields: RB813BA4, RB811BB4, RB807AQ4, RB755AY4, RB811BM4 and RB811AM4. AX negative-control origin is RB807AM4 while its annotation reads RB807AQ4. AW negative-control origin explicitly reads RB811AN4, distinct from RB755 RB811AS4.
Native BB/BD indicator destinations are KT441/KT431. Footer connector details include the printed E04/E06 pins and the asymmetric02E-C4C2B04 versus02F-C4C2B05 strings; neither is normalized.

Node AK second input is D07, not the initial D02 candidate. Both AE and AM have three coded inputs at function/unit/location rows; these are independently inspected, not copied from a two-input template.
